name: Kernel Ring Buffer
author: brunonlinespace
description: Read-only inspector for the current Linux kernel printk ring buffer, reading /dev/kmsg directly to preserve native record headers, sequence numbers, monotonic timestamps, priorities, facilities, flags, optional caller metadata, machine-readable continuation tags, message text and raw records.

capabilities.label: Kernel ring buffer
capabilities.standard: Reads the current printk ring buffer directly through /dev/kmsg when ordinary access is permitted.
capabilities.elevated: Reads the same fixed /dev/kmsg interface through the verified root-owned helper while in-place privileged access is active.
